metadata.name: Project Gutenberg
metadata.description: 公开版权电子书站点，提供免登录 EPUB、TXT 等格式下载，可用于测试完整下载到本地阅读流程。
metadata.author: ManXia Team
metadata.notes: 用于免登录测试完整电子书下载与本地阅读链路。

actions.code: (() => { const results = []; const seen = {}; const links = document.querySelectorAll('#books-last1 + ol li a[href*="/ebooks/"]'); links.forEach((link, index) => { if (index >= 30) { return; } const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; let url = ''; let bookId = ''; try { const absoluteUrl = new URL(href, location.href); url = absoluteUrl.toString(); bookId = absoluteUrl.pathname.replace('/ebooks/', '').replace(/^\/+/, ''); } catch (_error) { return; } if (!bookId || seen[bookId]) { return; } seen[bookId] = true; const rawText = String(link.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const cleanedText = rawText.replace(/\s*\(\d+\)\s*$/, ''); const marker = ' by '; const markerIndex = cleanedText.lastIndexOf(marker); let title = cleanedText; let author = ''; if (markerIndex > 0) { title = cleanedText.substring(0, markerIndex).trim(); author = cleanedText.substring(markerIndex + marker.length).trim(); } results.push({ id: bookId, title: title, author: author, cover: 'https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/' + bookId + '/pg' + bookId + '.cover.small.jpg', url: url }); }); return JSON.stringify(results); })();

(() => { const results = []; const seen = {}; const links = document.querySelectorAll('li.booklink a.link[href*="/ebooks/"]'); links.forEach((link) => { const href = link.getAttribute('href') || ''; let url = ''; let bookId = ''; try { const absoluteUrl = new URL(href, location.href); url = absoluteUrl.toString(); bookId = absoluteUrl.pathname.replace('/ebooks/', '').replace(/^\/+/, ''); } catch (_error) { return; } if (!bookId || seen[bookId]) { return; } seen[bookId] = true; const title = String(link.querySelector('.title')?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const author = String(link.querySelector('.subtitle')?.textContent || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const cover = link.querySelector('img.cover-thumb')?.getAttribute('src') || ''; const absoluteCover = cover ? new URL(cover, location.href).toString() : ''; if (!title) { return; } results.push({ id: bookId, title: title, author: author, cover: absoluteCover, url: url }); }); return JSON.stringify(results); })();

(() => { const detail = { id: location.pathname.replace('/ebooks/', '').replace(/^\/+/, ''), title: '', cover: '', author: '', publisher: 'Project Gutenberg', publishDate: '', description: '', categories: '', isbn: '', fileSize: '', formats: [] }; const clean = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const titleText = clean(document.querySelector('#book_title')?.textContent || ''); const marker = ' by '; const markerIndex = titleText.lastIndexOf(marker); if (markerIndex > 0) { detail.title = clean(titleText.substring(0, markerIndex)); detail.author = clean(titleText.substring(markerIndex + marker.length)); } else { detail.title = titleText; } const cover = document.querySelector('#cover img.cover-art')?.getAttribute('src') || ''; detail.cover = cover ? new URL(cover, location.href).toString() : ''; const summary = document.querySelector('.summary-text-container'); if (summary) { detail.description = clean(summary.textContent || ''); } const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#about_book_table tr'); const subjects = []; rows.forEach((row) => { const key = clean(row.querySelector('th')?.textContent || ''); const value = clean(row.querySelector('td')?.textContent || ''); if (key === 'Release Date') { detail.publishDate = value; } if (key === 'Subject' && value) { subjects.push(value); } }); detail.categories = subjects.slice(0, 3).join(' | '); const formats = []; const seen = {}; const registerFormat = (name, href) => { const normalizedName = clean(name).toUpperCase(); const normalizedHref = String(href || ''); if (!normalizedHref) { return; } let format = ''; const lowerHref = normalizedHref.toLowerCase(); const lowerName = normalizedName.toLowerCase(); if (lowerHref.includes('.epub') || lowerHref.includes('.epub3') || lowerName.includes('epub')) { format = 'EPUB'; } else if (lowerHref.includes('.txt') || lowerName.includes('plain text') || lowerName.includes('txt')) { format = 'TXT'; } else if (lowerHref.includes('.mobi') || lowerHref.includes('.kf8') || lowerHref.includes('.kindle') || lowerName.includes('kindle') || lowerName.includes('mobi')) { format = 'MOBI'; } if (!format || seen[format]) { return; } seen[format] = true; formats.push(format); }; const featured = document.querySelector('.featured-format-link'); if (featured) { registerFormat(featured.textContent || '', featured.getAttribute('href') || ''); } const others = document.querySelectorAll('.other-format-link'); others.forEach((link) => { registerFormat(link.textContent || '', link.getAttribute('href') || ''); }); detail.formats = formats; return JSON.stringify(detail); })();

(() => { const results = []; const seen = {}; const clean = (value) => String(value || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const pushFormat = (titleText, href, preferred) => { const absoluteUrl = href ? new URL(href, location.href).toString() : ''; const lowerHref = absoluteUrl.toLowerCase(); const lowerTitle = clean(titleText).toLowerCase(); let format = ''; if (lowerHref.includes('.epub') || lowerHref.includes('.epub3') || lowerTitle.includes('epub')) { format = 'EPUB'; } else if (lowerHref.includes('.txt') || lowerTitle.includes('plain text') || lowerTitle.includes('txt')) { format = 'TXT'; } else if (lowerHref.includes('.mobi') || lowerHref.includes('.kf8') || lowerHref.includes('.kindle') || lowerTitle.includes('kindle') || lowerTitle.includes('mobi')) { format = 'MOBI'; } if (!format || !absoluteUrl || seen[format]) { return; } seen[format] = true; results.push({ id: format.toLowerCase(), title: format, url: absoluteUrl, number: preferred ? 1 : results.length + 1 }); }; const featured = document.querySelector('.featured-format-link'); if (featured) { pushFormat(featured.textContent || '', featured.getAttribute('href') || '', true); } const others = document.querySelectorAll('.other-format-link'); others.forEach((link) => { pushFormat(link.textContent || '', link.getAttribute('href') || '', false); }); return JSON.stringify(results); })();
